canonical_statement: Produce two nonempty finite sets P and Q of positive prime integers such that (sum_{p in P} 1/p)(sum_{q in Q} 1/q)=1 exactly. Each list is a set (no repeated member). Primes below 2^64 are checked deterministically; larger primes require a recursively complete Lucas certificate of their primality. The input caps constrain the machine representation only: any accepted witness proves the unrestricted existential statement, while an unsuccessful bounded search proves nothing about nonexistence.
success_criterion: amf.erdos307.exact.v1 accepts after checking set semantics, every prime or recursive primality certificate, and the rational identity with arbitrary-precision integer arithmetic. Proof-assistant closure and independent fidelity/novelty review remain separate post-acceptance steps.
partial_progress_criterion: Retain reproducible search reductions, stronger cardinality or prime-product barriers, certified infeasible subclasses, and Lean lemmas even when no accepted witness is found.
stop_conditions: The fixed upstream statement or its set conventions fail a statement-fidelity review.
The candidate exceeds the explicit representation limits or verifier integrity is uncertain.
The separately approved experiment budget is exhausted.
